svg.title: Secure RAG AI Chatbot — Platform Architecture
svg.desc: Document indexing and staff questions share the existing protected platform.

g.text: Secure RAG AI Chatbot — Platform Architecture
Document indexing and staff questions share the existing protected platform.
Staff sign-in and API access tokens.
Current account, staff and role checks.
API refreshes staff and source rights.
Index timer in the API host
Five-minute UTC timer or Admin action.
Claims one SQL job using a lease.
Filter eligible sources before text load.
Exact source version, ETag and hash.
Read PDF, DOCX and existing text locally.
Whole file sent; selected pages processed.
Question + up to five permitted passages.
Managed identity; no tools or paid retry.
Audit and settle usage before disclosure.
No public Blob URLs or invented sources.
Recheck rights and exact Blob version.
PDF viewer or protected file download.
Private endpoints and DNS reach AI.
Managed AI accounts remain outside VNets.
SQL policies, leased jobs, chunks, audit and usage share the existing application database; there is no vector database or Azure AI Search tier.
The index timer runs in the API host. There is no dedicated RAG/OCR container or Service Bus indexing queue.
AI access uses managed identity and connectivity-Hub private endpoints/DNS. Routine RAG audit avoids raw prompts and document text.
Architecture, not a live health check: feature flags and source permissions control execution. Python examples model the core flow locally.
Purpose icons follow the established portfolio design. No private resource names, account identifiers or document contents are shown.
